# EnterpriseGlue v0.35.3 Release Notes

Generated from release-note fragments changed since `v0.35.2`.

## Highlights

- **git-providers:** Remove the Bitbucket SDK and its unfixed deepmerge dependency while preserving the Bitbucket Cloud provider API.
- **plugin-toolchain:** Rebuild plugin acquisition tools with the patched Go JOSE JWK parser.

## User and administrator impact

- Bitbucket repository, branch, file, commit and tag operations retain their provider interface.
- Bitbucket multipart uploads use the supplied provider credential directly.
- Plugin acquisition and signature verification keep their existing interfaces.

## Upgrade and compatibility

- Upgrade to qualified release images or refresh the corresponding published host packages.
- Adopt the newly qualified signed installer and manager image composition; existing published digests remain unchanged.

## Database migrations

- No schema or migration changes.
- No database or migration changes.
- Database rollback supported for the combined release: yes.

## Security

- Remove production deepmerge 4.3.1 rather than suppress CVE-2026-93753. All-severity scanner gates and ignore policy remain unchanged.
- Pin github.com/go-jose/go-jose/v4 to v4.1.6 in both Cosign builds to address CVE-2026-116587 (GHSA-mgcc-cww5-fp2q).
- Inspect the emitted binaries for the fixed module version. Preserve the upstream 4096-bit JWK RSA modulus limit and all existing scanner thresholds and ignore policy.

## Known limitations

- Protected database, real-engine browser and exact-image security candidate gates remain required before publication.
- The security fix refuses JWK RSA moduli larger than 4096 bits. Exact-candidate cross-architecture and signature compatibility qualification remains required.

## Rollback

- Prefer a qualified forward release; rolling back restores the vulnerable deepmerge dependency.
- Prefer a qualified forward release; older toolchain images retain the vulnerable JWK parser.

## Validation evidence

- Native-fetch HTTP contracts cover the Bitbucket provider operations and real loopback JSON/multipart transfer, authentication, redirect refusal and sanitized errors.
- Backend units, typecheck, compiled package-consumer checks and release/package/license/documentation guards pass locally.
- Native ARM64 application and frozen-bootstrap images have no unignored findings under the unchanged all-severity scanner policy. Real PostgreSQL bootstrap, idempotence, drift rejection and compiled historical upgrades pass.
- Protected exact-candidate cross-architecture, physical database and real-engine browser checks remain publication gates.
- Installer and manager unit suites, dependency-security contracts, package/chart version discipline, chart validation, release policy, strict licenses and documentation checks pass locally.
- Real Go JOSE tests verify supported RSA signing and reject oversized moduli and inconsistent private factors without raising the upstream 4096-bit limit.
- Native ARM64 installer and manager images pass the unchanged HIGH/CRITICAL toolchain gate; lower-severity observations remain in scan artifacts. The same patched Cosign bytes verify real public Fulcio/Rekor candidate signatures and local blob-signature/tamper checks.
- Protected exact-candidate cross-architecture and complete runtime qualification remains required before publication.
